### FILE: apps\planning\migrations\0011_task_work_status.py
### SIZE: 601 bytes / 19 lines

from django.db import migrations


def set_work_status(apps, schema_editor):
    Task = apps.get_model("planning", "Task")
    Task.objects.filter(kind="receive", status="open").update(status="to_receive")
    Task.objects.filter(kind="pick", status="open").update(status="to_pick")
    Task.objects.filter(kind="ship", status="open").update(status="to_ship")


class Migration(migrations.Migration):

    dependencies = [
        ("planning", "0010_purchase_customer_line"),
    ]

    operations = [
        migrations.RunPython(set_work_status, migrations.RunPython.noop),
    ]

### SIZE: 777 bytes / 23 lines

from django.db import migrations, models


def mark_chosen_grades(apps, schema_editor):
    OrderLine = apps.get_model("planning", "OrderLine")
    OrderLineGrade = apps.get_model("planning", "OrderLineGrade")
    OrderLine.objects.filter(id__in=OrderLineGrade.objects.values("order_line_id")).update(grade_manual=True)


class Migration(migrations.Migration):

    dependencies = [
        ("planning", "0011_task_work_status"),
    ]

    operations = [
        migrations.AddField(
            model_name="orderline",
            name="grade_manual",
            field=models.BooleanField(default=False, verbose_name="Сорт задан в заказе"),
        ),
        migrations.RunPython(mark_chosen_grades, migrations.RunPython.noop),
    ]

import django.db.models.deletion
from django.db import migrations, models


def fill_printers(apps, schema_editor):
    Printer = apps.get_model("printing", "Printer")
    PurchaseOrder = apps.get_model("planning", "PurchaseOrder")
    printer = Printer.objects.filter(printer_type="tsc", is_default=True).first()
    if printer is None:
        printer = Printer.objects.filter(printer_type="tsc").first()
    if printer is None:
        return
    PurchaseOrder.objects.filter(printer__isnull=True).update(printer_id=printer.id)


class Migration(migrations.Migration):

    dependencies = [
        ("printing", "0001_initial"),
        ("planning", "0013_purchase_gate"),
    ]

    operations = [
        migrations.AddField(
            model_name="purchaseorder",
            name="printer",
            field=models.ForeignKey(
                blank=True,
                null=True,
                on_delete=django.db.models.deletion.SET_NULL,
                related_name="purchase_orders",
                to="printing.printer",
                verbose_name="Принтер",
            ),
        ),
        migrations.AddField(
            model_name="task",
            name="assignee",
            field=models.ForeignKey(
                blank=True,
                null=True,
                on_delete=django.db.models.deletion.SET_NULL,
                related_name="assigned_tasks",
                to="accounts.user",
                verbose_name="Сотрудник",
            ),
        ),
        migrations.RunPython(fill_printers, migrations.RunPython.noop),
    ]

import django.db.models.deletion
from django.db import migrations, models


def use_onec_numbers(apps, schema_editor):
    Order = apps.get_model("planning", "Order")
    taken = set(Order.objects.values_list("number", flat=True))
    for order in Order.objects.exclude(external_number__isnull=True).exclude(external_number=""):
        external = (order.external_number or "").strip()
        if not external or order.number == external or external in taken:
            continue
        taken.discard(order.number)
        taken.add(external)
        order.number = external
        order.save(update_fields=["number"])

def sync_closed_picks(apps, schema_editor):
    from apps.planning.models import Order
    from apps.planning.services import sync_order_pick_status

from django.db import migrations


def mark_receive_progress(apps, schema_editor):
    Task = apps.get_model("planning", "Task")
    Movement = apps.get_model("inventory", "Movement")
    started = Movement.objects.filter(kind="in").exclude(task_id=None).values("task_id")
    (
        Task.objects.filter(kind="receive", status__in=["open", "to_receive", "assigned"], pk__in=started)
        .update(status="in_work")
    )
    (
        Task.objects.filter(kind="receive", status__in=["open", "to_receive"], assignee__isnull=False)
        .exclude(pk__in=started)
        .update(status="assigned")
    )

from decimal import Decimal

from django.db import migrations
from django.db.models import Sum


def _kg(value) -> Decimal:
    return Decimal(value or 0)


def retitle_pick_statuses(apps, schema_editor):
    Task = apps.get_model("planning", "Task")
    TaskLine = apps.get_model("planning", "TaskLine")
    Movement = apps.get_model("inventory", "Movement")
    PickAllocation = apps.get_model("picking", "PickAllocation")
    for task in Task.objects.filter(kind="pick").iterator():
        lines = list(TaskLine.objects.filter(task_id=task.pk))
        facts = {}
        if lines:
            rows = (
                Movement.objects.filter(kind="pick", task_line_id__in=[line.id for line in lines])
                .values("task_line_id")
                .annotate(total=Sum("qty_kg"))
            )
            facts = {row["task_line_id"]: _kg(row["total"]) for row in rows}
        all_done = bool(lines) and all(_kg(line.qty_kg) <= facts.get(line.id, Decimal("0")) for line in lines)
        if task.status == "closed" and not all_done:
            continue
        any_fact = any(facts.get(line.id, Decimal("0")) > 0 for line in lines)
        any_plan = PickAllocation.objects.filter(task_line__task_id=task.pk).exists()
        if all_done:
            new = "picked"
        elif any_fact:
            new = "in_work"
        elif any_plan:
            new = "planned"
        else:
            new = "created"
        if task.status != new:
            task.status = new
            task.save(update_fields=["status"])

from decimal import Decimal

from django.db import migrations
from django.db.models import Sum


def mark_partial_plans(apps, schema_editor):
    Task = apps.get_model("planning", "Task")
    TaskLine = apps.get_model("planning", "TaskLine")
    PickAllocation = apps.get_model("picking", "PickAllocation")
    for task in Task.objects.filter(kind="pick", status="planned").iterator():
        lines = list(TaskLine.objects.filter(task_id=task.pk))
        rows = (
            PickAllocation.objects.filter(task_line__task_id=task.pk)
            .values("task_line_id")
            .annotate(total=Sum("qty_kg"))
        )
        planned = {row["task_line_id"]: Decimal(row["total"] or 0) for row in rows}
        if not planned:
            continue
        if any(planned.get(line.id, Decimal("0")) < Decimal(line.qty_kg or 0) for line in lines):
            task.status = "partial"
            task.save(update_fields=["status"])

    caliber_mode = models.CharField(max_length=16, default="any")
    caliber = models.ForeignKey(
        "catalog.Caliber", null=True, blank=True, on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="exact_lines"
    )
    caliber_from = models.ForeignKey(
        "catalog.Caliber", null=True, blank=True, on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="range_from_lines"
    )
    caliber_to = models.ForeignKey(
        "catalog.Caliber", null=True, blank=True, on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="range_to_lines"
    )
    qty_kg = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=3)
    grades = models.ManyToManyField("catalog.Grade", through="OrderLineGrade", related_name="order_lines")
    grade_manual = models.BooleanField("Сорт задан в заказе", default=False)

    class Meta:
        db_table = "order_lines"
        verbose_name = "Строка заказа"
        verbose_name_plural = "Строки заказов"

    def external_title(self) -> str:
        code = self.external_code
        name = self.external_name
        if self.external_product_id:
            if not code:
                code = self.external_product.code
            if not name:
                name = self.external_product.name
        if code and name:
            return f"{code} · {name}"
        return name or code or ""

    def warehouse_product(self):
        if self.external_product_id:
            try:
                return self.external_product.alias.product
            except ProductAlias.DoesNotExist:
                return None
        if self.product_id:
            return self.product
        return None

    def product_title(self) -> str:
        product = self.warehouse_product()
        if product is not None:
            return product.name
        return self.external_title() or "без товара"

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{describe_line(self)}, {format_kg(self.qty_kg)} кг"

    def external_title(self) -> str:
        code = self.external_code
        name = self.external_name
        if self.external_product_id:
            if not code:
                code = self.external_product.code
            if not name:
                name = self.external_product.name
        if code and name:
            return f"{code} · {name}"
        return name or code or ""

    def product_title(self) -> str:

            return self.product.name

    def __str__(self):

        if self.caliber_id:
            parts.append(self.caliber.name)
        if self.grade_id:
            parts.append(self.grade.name)
        parts.append(f"{format_kg(self.qty_kg)} кг")
        return ", ".join(parts)


class Task(models.Model):
    number = models.CharField(max_length=32, unique=True, null=True, blank=True)
    order = models.ForeignKey(Order, null=True, blank=True, on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="tasks")
    purchase_order = models.ForeignKey(
        PurchaseOrder, null=True, blank=True, on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="tasks"
    )
    kind = models.CharField(max_length=16)
    status = models.CharField(max_length=32, default="open")
    supplier = models.ForeignKey("catalog.Supplier", null=True, blank=True, on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="tasks")
    ttn_number = models.CharField(max_length=80, blank=True, default="")
    doc_date = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True)
    receipt = models.ForeignKey("receiving.Receipt", null=True, blank=True, on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="tasks")
    assignee = models.ForeignKey(
        "accounts.User",
        null=True,
        blank=True,
        on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        related_name="assigned_tasks",
        verbose_name="Сотрудник",
    )
    created_by = models.ForeignKey("accounts.User", on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="tasks_created")
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = "tasks"
        verbose_name = "Задание"
        verbose_name_plural = "Задания"

    def is_closed(self) -> bool:
        if self.status == "closed":
            return True
        return self.kind == "pick" and self.status == "picked"

    def is_working(self) -> bool:
        if self.kind == "receive" and self.status in ("assigned", "in_work"):
            return True
        if self.kind == "pick":
            return self.status in ("created", "partial", "planned", "in_work")
        return self.status == TASK_WORK_STATUS.get(self.kind)

    def __str__(self):
        return self.number or f"#{self.pk}"


class TaskLine(models.Model):
    task = models.ForeignKey(Task, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name="lines")

        "catalog.Caliber", null=True, blank=True, on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="task_lines"
    )
    grade = models.ForeignKey(
        "catalog.Grade", null=True, blank=True, on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="task_lines"
    )
    qty_kg = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=3)

    class Meta:
        db_table = "task_lines"
        verbose_name = "Строка задания"
        verbose_name_plural = "Строки заданий"

    def __str__(self):
        parts = [self.product.name]
        if self.caliber_id:
            parts.append(self.caliber.name)
        if self.grade_id:
            parts.append(self.grade.name)
        parts.append(f"{format_kg(self.qty_kg)} кг")
        return ", ".join(parts)

### FILE: apps\planning\purchase_revisions.py

from datetime import date

from apps.common.constants import PURCHASE_STATUS
from apps.common.kg import as_kg
from apps.planning.models import PurchaseOrder, PurchaseOrderRevision
from apps.planning.revisions import empty_changes, has_diff

HEADER_FIELDS = (
    ("supplier", "Поставщик"),
    ("doc_date", "Дата"),
    ("receipt_date", "Дата поступления"),
    ("status", "Состояние"),
    ("comment", "Комментарий"),
)


def header_snapshot(order: PurchaseOrder) -> dict:
    return {
        "supplier": order.supplier.name,
        "doc_date": order.doc_date.isoformat(),
        "receipt_date": order.receipt_date.isoformat() if order.receipt_date else "",
        "status": order.status,
        "comment": (order.comment or "").strip(),
    }


def line_snapshot(order: PurchaseOrder) -> list[dict]:
    rows = []
    for line in order.lines.select_related("product", "caliber", "grade").order_by("id"):
        if line.external_code:
            rows.append(
                {
                    "code": line.external_code,
                    "name": line.external_name or line.product_title(),
                    "qty": str(as_kg(line.qty_kg)),
                }
            )
            continue
        name = line.product_title()
        if line.caliber_id:
            name = f"{name}, {line.caliber.name}"
        if line.grade_id:
            name = f"{name}, {line.grade.name}"
        rows.append(
            {
                "code": f"p{line.product_id}:{line.caliber_id or 0}:{line.grade_id or 0}",
                "name": name,
                "qty": str(as_kg(line.qty_kg)),
            }
        )
    return rows


def incoming_lines(lines: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
    return [
        {
            "code": item["external_code"],
            "name": item["external_name"],
            "qty": str(as_kg(item["qty_kg"])),
        }
        for item in lines
    ]


def _show_date(value: str) -> str:
    if not value:
        return ""
    try:
        return date.fromisoformat(value).strftime("%d.%m.%Y")
    except ValueError:
        return value


def _show(field: str, value: str) -> str:
    if field in ("doc_date", "receipt_date"):
        return _show_date(value)
    if field == "status":
        return PURCHASE_STATUS.get(value, value)
    return value


def diff_purchase(before_header: dict, before_lines: list[dict], after_header: dict, after_lines: list[dict]) -> dict:
    changes = empty_changes()
    for key, label in HEADER_FIELDS:
        old = before_header.get(key) or ""
        new = after_header.get(key) or ""
        if old != new:
            changes["header"].append({"field": label, "before": _show(key, old), "after": _show(key, new)})
    before = {}
    after = {}
    for row in before_lines:
        before.setdefault(row["code"], []).append(row)
    for row in after_lines:
        after.setdefault(row["code"], []).append(row)
    for code in sorted(set(before) | set(after)):
        old_rows = sorted(before.get(code, []), key=lambda row: (row["name"], row["qty"]))
        new_rows = sorted(after.get(code, []), key=lambda row: (row["name"], row["qty"]))
        paired = min(len(old_rows), len(new_rows))
        for index in range(paired):
            old = old_rows[index]
            new = new_rows[index]
            if old["qty"] == new["qty"] and old["name"] == new["name"]:
                continue
            changes["changed"].append(
                {
                    "code": code,
                    "name": new["name"],
                    "before_name": old["name"],
                    "before": old["qty"],
                    "after": new["qty"],
                }
            )
        changes["added"].extend(new_rows[paired:])
        changes["removed"].extend(old_rows[paired:])
    return changes


def _date(value: str):
    return date.fromisoformat(value) if value else None


def _store(order: PurchaseOrder, revision: int, header: dict, lines: list[dict], changes: dict, user) -> None:
    PurchaseOrderRevision.objects.create(
        order=order,
        revision=revision,
        doc_date=date.fromisoformat(header["doc_date"]),
        receipt_date=_date(header["receipt_date"]),
        supplier_name=header["supplier"],
        status=header["status"],
        comment=header["comment"],
        lines=lines,
        changes=changes,
        created_by=user,
    )


def remember_version(order: PurchaseOrder, before_header: dict, before_lines: list[dict], user) -> int | None:
    if not order.revisions.exists():
        baseline = PurchaseOrderRevision.objects.create(
            order=order,
            revision=1,
            doc_date=date.fromisoformat(before_header["doc_date"]),
            receipt_date=_date(before_header["receipt_date"]),
            supplier_name=before_header["supplier"],
            status=before_header["status"],
            comment=before_header["comment"],
            lines=before_lines,
            changes=empty_changes(),
            created_by=user,
        )
        baseline.created_at = order.created_at
        baseline.save(update_fields=["created_at"])
    after_header = header_snapshot(order)
    after_lines = line_snapshot(order)
    actual = diff_purchase(before_header, before_lines, after_header, after_lines)
    if not has_diff(actual):
        return None
    next_revision = order.revisions.order_by("-revision").values_list("revision", flat=True).first() + 1
    _store(order, next_revision, after_header, after_lines, actual, user)
    order.revision = next_revision
    order.save(update_fields=["revision"])
    return next_revision


def store_baseline(order: PurchaseOrder, user) -> None:
    if order.revisions.exists():
        return
    _store(order, order.revision or 1, header_snapshot(order), line_snapshot(order), empty_changes(), user)


def apply_purchase_import(
    order: PurchaseOrder,
    user,
    *,
    supplier,
    doc_date,
    receipt_date,
    status: str,
    comment: str,
    lines: list[dict],
) -> dict:
    before_header = header_snapshot(order)
    before_lines = line_snapshot(order)
    after_header = {
        "supplier": supplier.name,
        "doc_date": doc_date.isoformat(),
        "receipt_date": receipt_date.isoformat() if receipt_date else "",
        "status": status,
        "comment": (comment or "").strip(),
    }
    wanted = diff_purchase(before_header, before_lines, after_header, incoming_lines(lines))
    if not has_diff(wanted):
        return {"kind": "same", "changes": wanted}
    from apps.inventory.models import Movement

    received = Movement.objects.filter(task__purchase_order=order, kind="in").exists()
    if order.status == "closed" or received:
        return {"kind": "closed", "changes": wanted}
    order.supplier = supplier
    order.doc_date = doc_date
    order.receipt_date = receipt_date
    order.status = status
    order.comment = (comment or "").strip()
    order.save()
    blocked = _apply_lines(order, lines)
    wanted["blocked"] = blocked
    revision = remember_version(order, before_header, before_lines, user)
    if revision is None:
        return {"kind": "blocked", "changes": wanted, "revision": order.revision}
    return {"kind": "updated", "changes": wanted, "revision": revision}


def _apply_lines(order: PurchaseOrder, lines: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
    from apps.planning.models import PurchaseOrderLine

    blocked = []
    pools: dict[str, list[PurchaseOrderLine]] = {}
    for line in order.lines.all().order_by("id"):
        if not line.external_code:
            continue
        pools.setdefault(line.external_code, []).append(line)
    used = set()
    for item in lines:
        pool = pools.get(item["external_code"]) or []
        line = next((row for row in pool if row.id not in used), None)
        if line is None:
            PurchaseOrderLine.objects.create(
                order=order,
                product_id=item["product_id"],
                external_product_id=item["external_product_id"],
                caliber_id=item.get("caliber_id"),
                grade_id=item.get("grade_id"),
                qty_kg=as_kg(item["qty_kg"]),
                external_code=item["external_code"],
                external_name=item["external_name"],
                unit=item.get("unit") or "кг",
                for_task=item.get("for_task", True),
            )
            continue
        used.add(line.id)
        if line.task_lines.exists() and as_kg(line.qty_kg) != as_kg(item["qty_kg"]):
            blocked.append({"code": item["external_code"], "name": item["external_name"], "text": "строка уже в задании"})
            continue
        line.external_name = item["external_name"]
        line.external_product_id = item["external_product_id"]
        line.unit = item.get("unit") or "кг"
        line.for_task = item.get("for_task", True)
        line.qty_kg = as_kg(item["qty_kg"])
        if item["product_id"] and not line.task_lines.exists():
            line.product_id = item["product_id"]
        line.save()
    for pool in pools.values():
        for line in pool:
            if line.id in used:
                continue
            if line.task_lines.exists():
                blocked.append(
                    {
                        "code": line.external_code,
                        "name": line.external_name or line.product_title(),
                        "text": "строка уже в задании",
                    }
                )
                continue
            line.delete()
    return blocked

from decimal import Decimal

from apps.common.kg import as_kg
from apps.inventory.models import Movement
from apps.inventory.services import available_kg_by_pallet, reworked_pallet_ids


def plan_kg(line) -> Decimal:
    if line.reserve_kg is not None:
        return as_kg(line.reserve_kg)
    return as_kg(line.qty_kg)


def _kept_kg(rows: list[dict], key: str) -> dict[int, Decimal]:
    pallet_ids = [row["pallet_id"] for row in rows]
    available = available_kg_by_pallet(pallet_ids)
    found: dict[int, Decimal] = {}
    for row in rows:
        qty = available.get(row["pallet_id"], Decimal("0.000"))
        if qty <= 0:
            continue
        ident = row[key]
        found[ident] = found.get(ident, Decimal("0.000")) + qty
    return found


def assigned_by_order_line(line_ids=None) -> dict[int, Decimal]:
    query = Movement.objects.filter(kind="in", pallet__reserved_line_id__isnull=False).exclude(
        pallet_id__in=reworked_pallet_ids()
    )
    if line_ids is not None:
        query = query.filter(pallet__reserved_line_id__in=list(line_ids))
    rows = list(query.values("pallet_id", "pallet__reserved_line_id"))
    return _kept_kg(rows, "pallet__reserved_line_id")


def holding_by_grade(line_ids=None) -> dict[int, list[tuple[int, Decimal]]]:
    query = Movement.objects.filter(kind="in", pallet__reserved_line_id__isnull=False).exclude(
        pallet_id__in=reworked_pallet_ids()
    )
    if line_ids is not None:
        query = query.filter(pallet__reserved_line_id__in=list(line_ids))
    rows = list(query.values("pallet_id", "pallet__reserved_line_id", "lot__grade_id"))
    available = available_kg_by_pallet([row["pallet_id"] for row in rows])
    found: dict[int, list[tuple[int, Decimal]]] = {}
    for row in rows:
        qty = available.get(row["pallet_id"], Decimal("0.000"))
        if qty <= 0:
            continue
        found.setdefault(row["pallet__reserved_line_id"], []).append((row["lot__grade_id"], qty))
    return found


def holding_by_order_line(line_ids=None) -> dict[int, Decimal]:
    return assigned_by_order_line(line_ids)


def client_reserved_pools() -> dict[int, list[dict]]:
    rows = list(
        Movement.objects.filter(
            kind="in",
            pallet__reserved_consignee_id__isnull=False,
            pallet__reserved_line_id__isnull=True,
            pallet__order_id__isnull=True,
        )
        .exclude(pallet_id__in=reworked_pallet_ids())
        .select_related("lot__caliber", "pallet")
    )
    available = available_kg_by_pallet([movement.pallet_id for movement in rows])
    pools: dict[int, list[dict]] = {}
    for movement in rows:
        kg = available.get(movement.pallet_id, Decimal("0.000"))
        if kg <= 0:
            continue
        lot = movement.lot
        pools.setdefault(movement.pallet.reserved_consignee_id, []).append(
            {
                "product_id": lot.product_id,
                "caliber": lot.caliber,
                "grade_id": lot.grade_id,
                "kg": kg,
            }
        )
    return pools


def open_pallet_pools() -> list[dict]:
    rows = list(
        Movement.objects.filter(kind="in")
        .exclude(pallet_id__in=reworked_pallet_ids())
        .select_related("lot__caliber", "pallet")
        .prefetch_related("pallet__allowed_categories")
        .order_by("lot__received_on", "id")
    )
    available = available_kg_by_pallet([movement.pallet_id for movement in rows])
    pools = []
    for movement in rows:
        kg = available.get(movement.pallet_id, Decimal("0.000"))
        if kg <= 0:
            continue
        pallet = movement.pallet
        categories = {item.id for item in pallet.allowed_categories.all()}
        pools.append(
            {
                "product_id": movement.lot.product_id,
                "caliber": movement.lot.caliber,
                "grade_id": movement.lot.grade_id,
                "kg": kg,
                "origin_kg": kg,
                "category_ids": categories or None,
                "reserved_line_id": pallet.reserved_line_id,
                "reserved_consignee_id": pallet.reserved_consignee_id,
                "order_id": None if pallet.reserved_line_id else pallet.order_id,
            }
        )
    return pools


def legacy_reserved_pools() -> dict[int, list[dict]]:
    rows = list(
        Movement.objects.filter(kind="in", pallet__order_id__isnull=False, pallet__reserved_line_id__isnull=True)
        .exclude(pallet_id__in=reworked_pallet_ids())
        .select_related("lot__caliber", "pallet")
    )
    available = available_kg_by_pallet([movement.pallet_id for movement in rows])
    pools: dict[int, list[dict]] = {}
    for movement in rows:
        kg = available.get(movement.pallet_id, Decimal("0.000"))
        if kg <= 0:
            continue
        lot = movement.lot
        pools.setdefault(movement.pallet.order_id, []).append(
            {
                "product_id": lot.product_id,
                "caliber": lot.caliber,
                "grade_id": lot.grade_id,
                "kg": kg,
            }
        )
    return pools

### FILE: apps\planning\revisions.py

from datetime import date

from apps.common.exceptions import WarehouseError
from apps.common.kg import as_kg
from apps.planning.models import Order, OrderLine, OrderRevision
from apps.planning.services import delete_line, update_line_qty

HEADER_FIELDS = (
    ("consignee", "Грузополучатель"),
    ("seller", "Продавец"),
    ("ship_date", "Дата отгрузки"),
    ("terms", "Условия отгрузки"),
)


def empty_changes() -> dict:
    return {"header": [], "added": [], "removed": [], "changed": [], "blocked": []}


def has_diff(changes: dict) -> bool:
    return any(changes.get(key) for key in ("header", "added", "removed", "changed", "blocked"))


def revision_summary(changes: dict) -> str:
    if not changes:
        return "Исходная версия"
    parts = []
    header = changes.get("header") or []
    if header:
        parts.append(", ".join(item["field"] for item in header))
    added = changes.get("added") or []
    if added:
        parts.append(f"добавлено строк: {len(added)}")
    removed = changes.get("removed") or []
    if removed:
        parts.append(f"снято строк: {len(removed)}")
    changed = changes.get("changed") or []
    if changed:
        parts.append(f"изменено строк: {len(changed)}")
    blocked = changes.get("blocked") or []
    if blocked:
        parts.append(f"не применено: {len(blocked)}")
    return "; ".join(parts) or "Исходная версия"


def header_snapshot(order: Order) -> dict:
    consignee = order.consignee.name if order.consignee_id else ""
    return {
        "client": consignee,
        "consignee": consignee,
        "seller": order.seller.name,
        "ship_date": order.ship_date.isoformat(),
        "terms": (order.shipping_terms or "").strip(),
    }


def line_snapshot(order: Order) -> list[dict]:
    rows = []
    for line in order.lines.all().order_by("id"):
        if not line.external_code:
            continue
        rows.append(
            {
                "code": line.external_code,
                "name": line.external_name or line.product_title(),
                "qty": str(as_kg(line.qty_kg)),
            }
        )
    return rows


def incoming_header(*, client_name, consignee_name, seller_name, ship_date: date, terms: str) -> dict:
    return {
        "client": client_name,
        "consignee": consignee_name or client_name,
        "seller": seller_name,
        "ship_date": ship_date.isoformat(),
        "terms": (terms or "").strip(),
    }


def incoming_lines(lines: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
    return [
        {
            "code": item["external_code"],
            "name": item["external_name"],
            "qty": str(as_kg(item["qty_kg"])),
        }
        for item in lines
    ]


def _show_date(value: str) -> str:
    try:
        return date.fromisoformat(value).strftime("%d.%m.%Y")
    except ValueError:
        return value


def _show_header(field: str, value: str) -> str:
    if field == "ship_date":
        return _show_date(value)
    return value


def diff_states(before_header: dict, before_lines: list[dict], after_header: dict, after_lines: list[dict]) -> dict:
    changes = empty_changes()
    for key, label in HEADER_FIELDS:
        old = before_header.get(key) or ""
        new = after_header.get(key) or ""
        if old != new:
            changes["header"].append(
                {"field": label, "before": _show_header(key, old), "after": _show_header(key, new)}
            )
    before = {}
    after = {}
    for row in before_lines:
        before.setdefault(row["code"], []).append(row)
    for row in after_lines:
        after.setdefault(row["code"], []).append(row)
    for code in sorted(set(before) | set(after)):
        old_rows = sorted(before.get(code, []), key=lambda row: (row["name"], row["qty"]))
        new_rows = sorted(after.get(code, []), key=lambda row: (row["name"], row["qty"]))
        paired = min(len(old_rows), len(new_rows))
        for index in range(paired):
            old = old_rows[index]
            new = new_rows[index]
            if old["qty"] == new["qty"] and old["name"] == new["name"]:
                continue
            changes["changed"].append(
                {
                    "code": code,
                    "name": new["name"],
                    "before_name": old["name"],
                    "before": old["qty"],
                    "after": new["qty"],
                }
            )
        changes["added"].extend(new_rows[paired:])
        changes["removed"].extend(old_rows[paired:])
    return changes


def _store(order: Order, revision: int, header: dict, lines: list[dict], changes: dict, user) -> None:
    OrderRevision.objects.create(
        order=order,
        revision=revision,
        ship_date=date.fromisoformat(header["ship_date"]),
        client_name=header["client"],
        consignee_name=header["consignee"],
        seller_name=header["seller"],
        shipping_terms=header["terms"],
        lines=lines,
        changes=changes,
        created_by=user,
    )


def remember_version(order: Order, before_header: dict, before_lines: list[dict], changes: dict, user) -> int | None:
    if not order.revisions.exists():
        baseline = OrderRevision.objects.create(
            order=order,
            revision=1,
            ship_date=date.fromisoformat(before_header["ship_date"]),
            client_name=before_header["client"],
            consignee_name=before_header["consignee"],
            seller_name=before_header["seller"],
            shipping_terms=before_header["terms"],
            lines=before_lines,
            changes=empty_changes(),
            created_by=user,
        )
        baseline.created_at = order.created_at
        baseline.save(update_fields=["created_at"])
    after_header = header_snapshot(order)
    after_lines = line_snapshot(order)
    actual = diff_states(before_header, before_lines, after_header, after_lines)
    actual["blocked"] = changes.get("blocked") or []
    if not has_diff(actual):
        return None
    next_revision = order.revisions.order_by("-revision").values_list("revision", flat=True).first() + 1
    _store(order, next_revision, after_header, after_lines, actual, user)
    order.revision = next_revision
    order.save(update_fields=["revision"])
    return next_revision


def store_baseline(order: Order, user) -> None:
    if order.revisions.exists():
        return
    _store(order, order.revision or 1, header_snapshot(order), line_snapshot(order), empty_changes(), user)


def apply_import(order: Order, user, *, consignee, seller, ship_date, terms: str, lines: list[dict]) -> dict:
    before_header = header_snapshot(order)
    before_lines = line_snapshot(order)
    wanted = diff_states(
        before_header,
        before_lines,
        incoming_header(
            client_name=consignee.name,
            consignee_name=consignee.name,
            seller_name=seller.name,
            ship_date=ship_date,
            terms=terms,
        ),
        incoming_lines(lines),
    )
    if not has_diff(wanted):
        return {"kind": "same", "changes": wanted}
    if order.status != "open":
        return {"kind": "closed", "changes": wanted}
    order.consignee = consignee
    order.seller = seller
    order.ship_date = ship_date
    order.shipping_terms = (terms or "").strip()
    order.save()
    blocked = _apply_lines(order, lines)
    from apps.catalog.grade_policy import stamp_order_grades

    stamp_order_grades(order)
    wanted["blocked"] = blocked
    revision = remember_version(order, before_header, before_lines, wanted, user)
    if revision is None:
        return {"kind": "blocked", "changes": wanted, "revision": order.revision}
    return {"kind": "updated", "changes": wanted, "revision": revision}


def _apply_lines(order: Order, lines: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
    blocked = []
    pools: dict[str, list[OrderLine]] = {}
    for line in order.lines.all().order_by("id"):
        if not line.external_code:
            continue
        pools.setdefault(line.external_code, []).append(line)
    used = set()
    for item in lines:
        pool = pools.get(item["external_code"]) or []
        line = next((row for row in pool if row.id not in used), None)
        if line is None:
            OrderLine.objects.create(
                order=order,
                product_id=item["product_id"],
                external_product_id=item["external_product_id"],
                caliber_mode="any",
                qty_kg=as_kg(item["qty_kg"]),
                external_code=item["external_code"],
                external_name=item["external_name"],
                unit=item.get("unit") or "кг",
                for_task=item.get("for_task", True),
            )
            continue
        used.add(line.id)
        fields = []
        if line.external_name != item["external_name"]:
            line.external_name = item["external_name"]
            fields.append("external_name")
        if line.external_product_id != item["external_product_id"]:
            line.external_product_id = item["external_product_id"]
            fields.append("external_product")
        if item["product_id"] and line.product_id != item["product_id"] and not line.task_lines.exists():
            line.product_id = item["product_id"]
            fields.append("product")
        unit = item.get("unit") or "кг"
        if line.unit != unit:
            line.unit = unit
            fields.append("unit")
        for_task = item.get("for_task", True)
        if line.for_task != for_task:
            line.for_task = for_task
            fields.append("for_task")
        if fields:
            line.save(update_fields=fields)
        if as_kg(line.qty_kg) == as_kg(item["qty_kg"]):
            continue
        try:
            update_line_qty(line, item["qty_kg"])
        except WarehouseError as exc:
            blocked.append({"code": item["external_code"], "name": item["external_name"], "text": str(exc)})
    for pool in pools.values():
        for line in pool:
            if line.id in used:
                continue
            try:
                delete_line(line)
            except WarehouseError as exc:
                blocked.append(
                    {
                        "code": line.external_code,
                        "name": line.external_name or line.product_title(),
                        "text": str(exc),
                    }
                )
    return blocked

import csv
import io
from datetime import date
from decimal import Decimal

from django.db import transaction
from django.db.models import Prefetch, Sum

from apps.catalog.families import critical_family
from apps.catalog.models import Caliber, Consignee, Grade, Product, ProductAlias, Seller, Supplier
from apps.catalog.parties import ensure_alias, warehouse_product
from apps.common.constants import PALLET_TYPE, TASK_WORK_STATUS, task_status_choices
from apps.common.exceptions import WarehouseError
from apps.common.forms import get_row
from apps.common.kg import as_kg, format_kg
from apps.common.numbers import document_number
from apps.common.present import line_caliber
from apps.inventory.models import Movement
from apps.inventory.services import kg_by, received_kg

def remaining_kg(line: OrderLine) -> Decimal:
    taken = Decimal("0.000")
    for task_line in line.task_lines.all():
        taken += as_kg(task_line.qty_kg)
    return as_kg(line.qty_kg) - taken


@transaction.atomic
def create_order(*, consignee_id, seller_id, ship_date, shipping_terms, user, number=None) -> Order:
    consignee = get_row(Consignee, consignee_id, "грузополучатель")
    seller = get_row(Seller, seller_id, "продавец")
    order = Order.objects.create(
        consignee=consignee,
        seller=seller,
        ship_date=ship_date,
        shipping_terms=shipping_terms.strip(),
